2609.11842.title: Model-Aware Schedules Improve Generation via Fiberwise Optimal Transport
2609.11842.paper_summary: Diffusion and flow-matching schedules control the signal and noise coefficients that mix data and noise along affine probability paths. Minimizing a kinetic action defined on coefficient paths, motivated by optimal transport, helps explain strong baselines but remains model-agnostic and ignores prediction error. Here we introduce a model-aware schedule construction based on fiberwise optimal transport. At a fixed time and state on the probability path, compatible signal/noise decompositions form an affine fiber. We define a fiberwise prediction risk by averaging optimal-transport costs between the true and predictor-induced decompositions within these fibers. On a fixed coefficient curve, combining this risk with coefficient-path kinetic action yields a closed-form optimal time allocation. This construction extends to general linear prediction targets, and the risk profile can be estimated from an early baseline checkpoint. We evaluate DDPMs and flow matching across prediction targets, training configurations, risk-estimation checkpoints, datasets, and architectures. Our model-aware schedules consistently outperform strong baselines, including a 38.6% relative FID reduction for flow matching on CIFAR-10 at 16 function evaluations. Each model-agnostic kinetic baseline determines its own kinetic reference coordinate. In these coordinates, fiberwise-risk profiles from independently trained models in different settings align closely after normalization to unit area. The resulting schedule deformations used in training also align, suggesting empirical universality across the evaluated models and settings. Pretrained-checkpoint diagnostics extend this normalized-risk agreement to larger conditional latent diffusion and 2-RF models. A frozen analytic allocation template retains most of the model-aware improvement without further risk estimation or model-specific fitting.
2609.11842.paper_summary_zh: 擴散和流匹配計劃控制沿著仿射概率路徑混合數據和噪聲的信號和噪聲係數。最小化在係數路徑上定義的動力學作用，受到最佳運輸的啟發，有助於解釋強基線，但仍然是模型無關的並忽略預測誤差。在這裡，我們介紹了一種基於纖維最佳運輸的模型感知計劃構建。在概率路徑上的固定時間和狀態下，兼容的信號/噪聲分解形成一個仿射纖維。我們通過在這些纖維中平均真實分解和預測者誘導分解之間的最佳運輸成本來定義一個纖維預測風險。在固定的係數曲線上，將這個風險與係數路徑動力學作用結合，產生一個封閉形式的最佳時間分配。這一構建擴展到一般線性預測目標，並且風險輪廓可以從早期基線檢查點進行估計。我們在預測目標、訓練配置、風險估計檢查點、數據集和架構上評估DDPM和流匹配。我們的模型感知計劃始終優於強基線，包括在16次函數評估中對CIFAR-10的流匹配相對FID減少38.6%。每個模型無關的動力學基線確定其自己的動力學參考坐標。在這些坐標中，來自不同環境中獨立訓練模型的纖維風險輪廓在標準化到單位面積後緊密對齊。用於訓練的最終計劃變形也對齊，這表明在評估的模型和環境中存在經驗普遍性。預訓練檢查點診斷將這一標準化風險協議擴展到更大的條件潛在擴散和2-RF模型。一個凍結的解析分配模板在不進一步風險估計或模型特定擬合的情況下保留了大部分模型感知的改進。
